title: Boolean averaging for the multilinear extension
statement: Let $P$ be a Boolean predicate on inputs with $m$ sign coordinates, and for each coordinate $i$ let $a_i$ assign a real number to each of the two Boolean choices. The uniform expectation over all Boolean choice vectors $\sigma$ of the multilinear extension of $P$ evaluated at the coordinates $a_i(\sigma_i)$ equals that extension evaluated at the coordinatewise averages $(a_i(0)+a_i(1))/2$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a sign predicate with arity $m$
$a$ assigns a real number to each coordinate and Boolean choice
